notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE: MASSIVE PLANETARY REDESIGN!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=dpyaQ9OB4kw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What's New:[/b]
The biggest change you'll notice in our latest video is the complete redesign of the planetary systems. The planets are now much larger and more visually impressive, creating a truly immersive space experience. These enhanced planetary environments feature stunning visual effects that bring the game world to life.

[b]Development Progress:[/b]
As a solo developer, I'm working hard to bring you the best space RTS experience possible. The game currently features one solar system with 6 unique planets, each with their own characteristics and strategic importance.


[b]Your Feedback Matters:[/b]
For those who've been following development, thank you for your continuous support and valuable feedback. Many of you have contributed ideas that have directly improved the game.

What aspects of the planetary redesign are you most excited about? I'd love to hear your thoughts in the comments below!

Dynasty Protocol - Build your stellar empire through strategy, conquest, and resource management.

notes.title: New Feature Showcase Trailer Released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=25FfO-ppmAM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Greetings, commanders!
[/b][/h1]

I'm excited to share a brand-new feature showcase trailer for Dynasty Protocol! This fast-paced video highlights everything the game has to offer in one comprehensive overview.

In this trailer, you'll get to see:

[list]
[*] Asteroid mining and resource extraction systems
[*] Cargo ships transporting minerals from mining operations to stations and outposts
[*] Advanced colony capture and management mechanics
[*] Colony governance including policy and tax management
[*] Empire Dashboard with resource trends and fleet status
[*] Strategic ship combat and fleet management
[*] Multiple unique factions with special abilities
[*] Modular space stations with various capabilities
[*] The dynamic galactic market economy
[*] Technology research trees for improved efficiency
[/list]
Dynasty Protocol offers UI language support for English, Turkish, Russian, German, French, and Brazilian Portuguese!

As a solo developer, your feedback is incredibly valuable to me. Let me know what features you're most excited about, or if there's anything else you'd like to see in future updates!

Don't forget to wishlist Dynasty Protocol if you haven't already, and follow my social media for regular development updates


Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Colony Governance Update: Shape Your Dynasty Through Policies & Taxation
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3438130/53b4887b4c58b61a0e3450567f16c3f4156b55d7/ss_53b4887b4c58b61a0e3450567f16c3f4156b55d7.1920x1080.jpg?t=1742459092[/img]

[b]Greetings, Commanders![/b]

I'm excited to reveal a major feature coming to Dynasty Protocol: the Colony Management System!

🌟 UPCOMING FEATURE: COLONY GOVERNANCE
The Colony Management System will put you in complete control of how your colonies operate across the galaxy:


[b]Tax Collection System:[/b]
Determine taxation rates on different resources extracted from each colony. Will you demand high titanium taxes while keeping oxygen levies low? Every decision impacts colonial productivity and satisfaction.

[b]Policy Implementation:[/b]
Choose from various governance policies that shape how your colonies function. Each policy brings unique advantages:

[b]Military Presence:[/b] 
Increases defense capabilities

[b]Economic Focus: [/b]
Boosts resource production

[b]And more![/b]

[b]Colony Happiness: [/b]
Your taxation decisions directly affect colony happiness. Neglect this at your peril - unhappy colonies will declare independence faster when left undefended!

[b]Strategic Risk Management:[/b]
Find the perfect balance between extracting maximum resources and maintaining colony loyalty. Push too hard, and you might trigger rebellion; be too gentle, and your empire might lack the resources to compete.

This feature represents another step toward creating the deep, strategic space RTS experience I've been working toward. Your decisions as a commander will extend beyond the battlefield to the political and economic landscape of your empire.

Stay tuned for more updates as I approach the release of Dynasty Protocol. Your interest and support during this development journey has been invaluable.

Commander out.
